value_notes.insured_risks.covered_risks: fire_explosion and burglary_theft only; water_damage and natural_events depend on the Schedule, which is not in the document

findings.quote: Water damage and natural events are covered only if stated in the Schedule.
findings.note: Marker 'only if' inside the quoted clause. The Schedule is a reference code cannot resolve, so unresolved_reference also applies.

findings.quote: The Insurer does not pay for war and military actions, gradual damage and wear, unauthorised construction, or losses while the home is vacant for more than 30 days.
The sum insured is USD 60,000, with a contents sublimit of USD 8,000.
The deductible is 10% of each loss.
Losses are paid at market value after deducting depreciation of 15% per year of age of the item.
The Insurer pays within 30 days after receiving all documents.
must notify the Insurer within 24 hours of discovering the loss
must keep an alarm connected to a security service and certified locks on all external doors
No refund is made on early termination.
The Insurer may recover paid amounts from the Policyholder if the Policyholder breached any obligation of this policy.

document.note: Clause 1.1 refers to a Schedule outside the document (lexicon list external). The browser flag unprovided_references applies to clause ids, so no flag is expected. No finding on clause 1.1 is green.
